name: Tennozu-Isle
tagline: Shinagawa in 17 minutes and Tokyo in 18 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, where Tokyo Monorail and Tokyo Waterfront Area Rapid Transit run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 24 minutes to Otemachi, 28 minutes to Shinjuku, 23 minutes to Shibuya and 17 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. The station stands 2.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.7 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 2.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.2 m to 3.9 m, a difference of 2.7 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 5 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 1 pharmacy. The nearest hospital is 河野臨牀医学研究所附属北品川病院, about 14 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 河野臨牀医学研究所附属第三北品川病院, about 18 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tokyo Monorail and Rinkai Line. The lines are split between operators (Tokyo Monorail runs 1 line and Tokyo Waterfront Area Rapid Transit runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Rinkai Line runs at 118% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大井町→品川シーサイド, which this station is not on. Tokyo Monorail is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 1K ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. 1LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000 and 2LDK ¥300,000 to ¥310,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. For One room, 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Shimbamba, but Tennozu-Isle is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Tennozu-Isle. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Tennozu-Isle. One-room rents run about ¥50,000 lower.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Kitashinagawa, but Tennozu-Isle is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Tennozu-Isle in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Tennozu-Isle. One-room rents run about ¥22,000 lower.

noiseSources: The 首都高速1号羽田線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
海岸通り (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: OpenStreetMap records no supermarket within walking distance of the station.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
